name: SalesBinder
description_en:
SalesBinder combines inventory with customer/supplier records, invoices, estimates and purchase orders. Its cloud offering also describes locations/zones, barcoding, transfers and permissions.

The main pricing distinction is active-record capacity rather than a simple product count. A small catalog can still consume capacity through customers and commercial documents, making record lifecycle management part of selection.
description_zh:
SalesBinder 将库存与客户供应商记录、发票、报价及采购单结合，云服务还描述地点与区域、条码、转移和权限。

其主要计费差异是活跃记录容量，并非单纯商品数。即使商品目录很小，客户和商务单据也会占用容量，因此记录生命周期是选型的一部分。

core_features.explanation_en: The product combines stock tracking with invoices, estimates, customer accounts and purchases.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品组合库存跟踪、发票、报价、客户账户及采购。

core_features.explanation_en: Pricing counts unique SKUs, contacts and invoices/estimates/purchase orders while excluding archived records.
core_features.explanation_zh: 价格将独立 SKU、联系人及发票、报价和采购单计入容量，归档记录不计。

Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Trace a purchase and sale through the record allowance
sections.title_zh: 跟踪采购销售与记录额度
sections.en: Create a supplier, inventory item and purchase order, receive stock, then create a customer and sales document. Check both stock changes and the number of active records consumed. The plan FAQ says the allowance is a running tally, not a monthly quota. Evaluate archiving against actual retention and reporting needs rather than deleting business history to fit a plan.
sections.zh: 创建供应商、库存商品和采购单，收货后创建客户与销售单据，同时检查库存变化和活跃记录占用。方案 FAQ 说明额度是当前累计量，并非月度配额。应结合保留及报表需要评估归档，不能靠删除业务历史迁就方案。

sections.title_en: Compare record, user and integration capacity
sections.title_zh: 比较记录、用户和集成容量
sections.en: USD monthly Starter/Bronze/Silver/Gold prices are $9/$19/$49/$99 with 2,500/5,000/25,000/100,000 active records. They include 1/5/25/50 users and 0/1/3/5 active integrations. Extra users are $3 monthly. Core features are described as full functionality, but integration capacity still differs. The page also labels kitting/bundling a $9 monthly add-on despite inclusion wording in cells; confirm entitlement.
sections.zh: Starter/Bronze/Silver/Gold 美元月价为 $9/$19/$49/$99，活跃记录 2,500/5,000/25,000/100,000，含 1/5/25/50 用户、0/1/3/5 活跃集成；额外用户 $3/月。虽然核心功能宣传完整，集成容量仍不同。页面将组套标为 $9/月附加项，但表格又有包含文字，需确认权限。

sections.title_en: Distinguish the trial from free-plan terms
sections.title_zh: 区分试用与免费方案条款
sections.en: A 30-day no-card paid-plan trial is documented, and the page contains a Free Forever navigation option. The captured standard-plan view does not establish that free plan’s capacity or integration limits, so it should not inherit paid allowances. Downgrading requires freeing enough records; cancellation does not erase charges already incurred.
sections.zh: 文档说明付费方案有 30 天无需信用卡试用，页面也有 Free Forever 入口，但本次标准方案视图未确认免费版容量或集成上限，不能继承付费额度。降级需先释放足够记录，取消不免除已产生费用。

sections.title_en: Test history access and connected accounting
sections.title_zh: 测试历史访问与会计连接
sections.en: Small businesses coordinating stock, sales documents and customer accounts can evaluate the combined model. Check a return, archived invoice lookup and permissions for staff with different responsibilities. A named accounting integration such as QuickBooks Online needs its own mapping and retry test. No account, archive restore, API or integration was operated.
sections.zh: 协调库存、销售单据和客户账户的小企业可评估此组合。应检查退货、归档发票查找及不同员工权限。QuickBooks Online 等会计连接还需独立测试映射与重试。未实际操作账户、归档恢复、API 或集成。
